scannerInput.title: Reading Input with Scanner
whereToLook: Make sure you create a Scanner object connected to System.in.
Use nextDouble() to read each score as a double.
Read the five scores in the exact order the prompts are displayed: first, second, third, fourth, fifth.

methods.title: Writing and Calling Methods
whereToLook: calcAverage should accept all five scores as parameters and return their average as a double.
determineGrade should accept a single score as a parameter and return a String grade.
Call determineGrade separately for each of the five scores, and again for the average score.

gradingLogic.title: Determining the Grade
whereToLook: Review the score ranges in the README table for Fail, Pass, Excel, and Warning.
Pay close attention to the boundary values (3.0/3.1, 6.0/6.1, 9.0) to make sure each lands in the correct range.
A score over 9.0 should always return "Warning", even when checking the average score.

closingProgram.title: Closing the Program
whereToLook: After displaying the results, call System.exit(0) as the last statement in main.

sourceChecks.name: Uses Scanner
sourceChecks.message: This challenge requires you to create a Scanner with System.in to read the user's five scores.

sourceChecks.name: Uses calcAverage method
sourceChecks.message: You must write and call a method named calcAverage to calculate the average of the five scores.

sourceChecks.name: Uses determineGrade method
sourceChecks.message: You must write and call a method named determineGrade to look up the grade for a score.

sourceChecks.name: Closes the program
sourceChecks.message: Call System.exit(0) as the last statement in main to close the program after displaying the results.
